scientific_use: Merge local image components connected at tile boundaries, applying minimum source size only after global merging.
scientific_purpose: Merge local image components connected at tile boundaries, applying minimum source size only after global merging.

source_references.title: Berkeley SoftFloat: software IEEE arithmetic methodology (no code copied)

canonical_equations: For each undirected connected component output min(component_id),sum(pixel_count),min(component_id) if total>=npixels else0; output one row per input node.
input_contract: encoding=uint32; unique nonzero component_ids[N],pixel_counts[N]>0,N1..512; edges[M,2] node indices,M0..8192; sum counts<=2^32-1; npixels1..2^32-1; caller supplies disjoint pixel sets and complete seam adjacency.
output_contract: N x [u32 canonical_id,u32 global_pixel_count,u32 accepted_id]; duplicates/self edges harmless; isolated components retained; does not discover missing edges or deblend.
result_contract: N x [u32 canonical_id,u32 global_pixel_count,u32 accepted_id]; duplicates/self edges harmless; isolated components retained; does not discover missing edges or deblend.
precision_requirements: Exact uint32 identifiers and checked uint32 component counts; no floating point.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.

licensing_provenance.implementation: Original ASTRO implementation of published equations; no external code copied.

RT_applicability: Mesh gathers, graph equivalences and ordered pixel reductions have no conservative ray/BVH pruning.
partition_strategy: whole component graph shared by output-node partitions; graph shards require explicit equivalence reconciliation
